en: The postcard shows a tranquil, landscaped park with a small lake or pond in the foreground, where several rowboats are moored along the bank. On the far side of the water, there is a well-maintained garden and a decorative pavilion or bandstand set against a wooded hillside. The trees are mature, and the paths are neatly arranged. The scene looks peaceful and designed for recreation and leisure. The photo is black and white, which adds an old-fashioned feel. Text in German is present in the lower left corner.
